grep -n "seven" README.md | grep -v "707\|777\|77 " ; echo "any-seven-exit=$?"; grep -rn "seven jobs" --include="*.md" . | grep -v node_modules | head; echo "md-seven-exit=$?"

echo "seven-count=$(grep -c 'seven' README.md)"; echo "---bullets---"; sed -n '597,606p' README.md | grep -c '^- \*\*'; echo "---makefile---"; grep -n "corpus-jsonl-selftest\|corpus-jsonl:" Makefile | head

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
wf = open('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read().splitlines()
# find jobs: top-level
ji = next(i for i,l in enumerate(wf) if l == 'jobs:')
jobs = []
for l in wf[ji+1:]:
    m = re.match(r'^  ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*):\s*$', l)
    if m: jobs.append(m.group(1))
    elif l and not l.startswith(' '): break
print("ci.yml job order:", jobs)
rd = open('README.md').read().splitlines()
s = next(i for i,l in enumerate(rd) if l.startswith('### CI/CD'))
sect = []
for l in rd[s+1:]:
    if l.startswith('## '): break
    sect.append(l)
census = next(l for l in sect if 'jobs in' in l)
ids = re.findall(r'`([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)`', census.split('ci.yml')[-1])
print("README census order:", ids)
print("census==file order:", ids == jobs)
bullets = [l for l in sect if l.startswith('- **')]
print("README bullets:", len(bullets))
for b in bullets: print("  ", b.split('—')[0].strip())
names = [re.search(r'\*\*`(.+?)`', b).group(1) for b in bullets]
wf_names = {}
cur = None
for l in wf[ji:]:
    m = re.match(r'^  ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*):\s*$', l)
    if m: cur = m.group(1)
    m2 = re.match(r'^    name: (.+)$', l)
    if m2: wf_names[cur] = m2.group(1)
print("bullet names == job names in order:", names == [wf_names[j] for j in jobs])
EOF
